About NovelNest

Learn what NovelNest offers, how licensed novels are published, and how original editorial content is created for readers.

What NovelNest offers

NovelNest is an independent web-novel library and reading site built to make long stories easier to discover, organize, and read chapter by chapter. Readers can browse by genre, follow ongoing releases, find completed stories, save bookmarks, continue from reading history, and adjust the reader for a more comfortable experience.

Publishing and rights

NovelNest only intends to publish full chapter text when the site owner has confirmed permission or another valid right to publish that material. Copyright in individual novels, cover art, characters, and other third-party works remains with the applicable authors, artists, publishers, or rights holders unless explicitly stated otherwise.

If you are a rights holder and believe something on NovelNest should not be available, please use the Copyright & Takedown page.

Accounts and reading data

Guest reading data such as bookmarks, preferences, and recent reading progress can be stored in the browser. Signed-in readers may use Google sign-in through Firebase Authentication, with supported library and reading information synchronized through Firebase services.

Original editorial content

The NovelNest Reading Desk publishes original guides and recommendations created for NovelNest readers. Editorial pages are separate from the text of licensed novels.
